title: Mistune: Path Traversal and XSS in Include directive
summary: Affected: mistune. The Include directive in `src/mistune/directives/include.py` does not validate that the resolved file path stays within the source directory, allowing path traversal via `../` sequences to read arbitrary files. Additionally, error messages and included file contents are rendered without HTML escaping, leading to XSS even when `escape=True`. Affected functions: - Path resolution (lines 27-31) - `block_error()` in html.py (line 140) - `render_html_include()` (line 72) The Include plugin must be explicitly enabled via the plugins parameter.

title: Moov signedxml: Unauthenticated denial of service in exclusive XML canonicalization
summary: Affected: github.com/moov-io/signedxml. title: fast-uri vulnerable to URI scheme spoofing via percent-encoded scheme decoding
summary: Affected: fast-uri, fast-uri, fast-uri. ### Impact `fast-uri` percent-decodes the scheme component with the legacy global `unescape()` before validating it, so an input whose decoded scheme is a valid but dangerous token is emitted as a live scheme. RFC 3986 section 3.1 does not allow percent-encoding in a scheme, so no RFC or WHATWG parser treats such input as having that scheme, but `fast-uri` does. title: chi: Client IP spoofing in ClientIPFromXFF via X-Forwarded-For
summary: Affected: github.com/go-chi/chi/v5. ### Summary `ClientIPFromXFF` skips any `X-Forwarded-For` entry in a configured trusted CIDR but never verifies that the direct TCP peer in `http.Request.RemoteAddr` belongs to that CIDR.
